The main takeaway from our work is that

the k -dependent intrasubband scattering effects on the optical gain are not important for a Gaussian line shape function, whereas the k -dependent scattering is very important for a Lorentz line shape function.
the inclusion of k dependence in the carrier-carrier scattering is important for a Lorentzianshape model but not so much for a Gaussian shape model, which is more efficient.
a Gaussian line gain model with constant intraband scattering times can be used for modeling of optical gain spectra in quantum wells with reasonable accuracy.
